brief.creative_description: Modern abstract background with indigo and silver flowing forms, refined texture, soft lighting, and generous calm content-safe areas.
brief.title: Community Excellence Awards

programme.title: Welcome by the master of ceremonies

direction.positive_prompt: Create an elegant and modern abstract background with indigo and silver flowing forms, The design should feature a refined texture and soft lighting, ensuring a visually calming and sophisticated atmosphere
direction.negative_prompt: Avoid any text, typography, lettering, words, logos, watermarks, writing, or any readable characters. Do not include any portraits or invented logos.
direction.short_design_rationale: This design direction emphasizes elegance and sophistication, aligning with the event's theme of a modern evening recognition. The use of indigo and silver creates a striking yet refined visual that is both modern and timeless.

direction.positive_prompt: Abstract flowing forms of indigo and silver, iridescent shimmer, fluid acrylic paint on dark canvas, soft volumetric lighting, deep shadows, refined texture, smooth gradients, elegant, ethereal, atmospheric depth, calm and spacious composition
direction.negative_prompt: harsh lines, sharp edges, text, logos, portraits, busy patterns, cluttered, noisy, low resolution, flat colors, overly bright, overly saturated.
direction.short_design_rationale: This direction uses abstract flowing forms in indigo and silver to create a sophisticated and calming background, reflecting the 'Modern evening recognition' theme and providing a strong visual identity without distracting from the event details. The soft lighting and refined textures add depth and elegance.

direction.positive_prompt: A modern abstract background with indigo and silver flowing forms, refined texture, soft lighting, and a calm atmosphere, The composition should feature a balance of negative space and intricate, elegant patterns that evoke a sense of sophistication and celebration, Use a subtle, reflective sheen to enhance the silver elements, creating a luxurious and serene ambiance
direction.negative_prompt: Any text, typography, lettering, words, logos, watermarks, writing, or readable characters. Avoid sharp edges, harsh contrasts, and overly bright colors.
direction.short_design_rationale: The design aims to capture the essence of a modern evening recognition event with a refined and elegant aesthetic. The use of indigo and silver colors, along with flowing forms and soft lighting, creates a sophisticated and calming atmosphere. The generous content-safe areas ensure that the reserved zones for text and other elements are clearly distinguishable and visually appealing.
